## Definition of Done (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Behavior covered by tests, written first (TDD).
- [ ] OpenSpec loop followed, or a documented exemption applies.
- [ ] `ruff` lint + `ruff format` clean.
- [ ] `mypy` strict passes with type hints everywhere.
- [ ] `pylint` passes.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes — no slow tests — and the coverage gate holds.
- [ ] `uv.lock` committed and consistent with `pyproject.toml`.
- [ ] No secrets/PII logged; header transparency preserved.
- [ ] Conventional Commit messages.
- [ ] thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review run on non-trivial changes.
